doubts: Loop: the circuit is described from Putara Road end and comes back to it. The three road-end features (F1, F2, F3) are all 'where an unnamed track meets PUTARA ROAD', so I could not tell which one is the start or the end; both are recorded by name with null refs. The direction is not stated, so it is null. Herepai Peak is recorded as a via because the text says to follow the sign to it and then the route to Dundas Hut begins from the bushline; the page does not say whether the peak is a side trip. Herepai Hut is recorded as on the way because the section begins at it, though it is reached by a 1.5 km track off the junction. The Ruamahanga River is recorded as a ford because the text says the track crosses it, and the bridge on the lower Ruamahanga is recorded with no how. The several unbridged streams are recorded as a ford with a null name. The Ruamahanga River is not in the names list, so no ref. The time '3 days' is DOC's summary; the section times are not summed and no distance is given for the whole way (the sections are 5 km, 5.2 km, 2.3 km and 7 km).
